changes.title: Wave dropdown
items: How often the waves come is now a dropdown in the top right of your bedroom, and every game starts at the usual pace unless you pick another (it's no longer remembered from last time)

changes.title: Cleared sting
items: Clearing an area before the pulse reaches it now plays a short "cleared!" sting

changes.title: No dodge marker
items: The little cyan diamond showing where a dodge would land is gone; dodging works as before
